answer: Continuous Cognitive Anchoring requires every agent to solve dynamic, personalized graph puzzles piped through a shifting cryptographic nebula every few minutes to maintain transaction rights. The attacker pays a massive opportunity cost because routing continuous attention across a swarm burns high-value hardware cycles that could otherwise yield direct mining revenue.
